question: How many more games were sold on game platform ID 50 than on game platform ID 51 in region ID 1?
gql: MATCH (t:region_sales) WHERE t.region_id = 1 RETURN ((sum(CASE WHEN t.game_platform_id = 50 THEN t.num_sales ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN t.game_platform_id = 51 THEN t.num_sales ELSE 0 END)) * 100000) AS nums
